commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg --files --hidden -g '"'!.git'"'; cat README.md requirements.md docs/export-notes.md tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat tasklist/cli.py tasklist/__init__.py; git log -1 --format='%h %s'; git diff --stat"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path('README.md'), Path('requirements.md'), Path('docs/task-completion.md'), Path('docs/work/task-completion.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    for target in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
        assert (page.parent / target.split('#')[0]).is_file(), (page, target)
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local documentation links across {len(pages)} pages; all resolve.')
assert Path('docs/export-notes.md').read_text().startswith('# Future export work\\n')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git diff -- README.md requirements.md; git status --short'
